notes.title: NEW GAME RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're releasing our new game, Riverhill Trials on April 12. It's a platform adventure with dozens of challenges, collectibles, achievements and amazing crafted graphics. Please check it out

http://store.steampowered.com/app/810460/Riverhill_Trials/

Thank you for your support and welcome to Riverhill!
